scope: Eight individual named screw envelopes against the actual lower-shell pilot surfaces. Dimension evidence for explicit nominal thread interfaces, not a source-mesh clearance or manufacturing certificate.

limitations: A named M2 part is not by itself evidence that a material overlap is acceptable.
